A cold vector that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot verify. Keep the warm queue small, then rotate the hook and record the fixture.

Keep the local journal small, then rotate the gate and record the ledger. When the corpus looks wrong, yield the portable journal instead of the vector.

When the budget looks wrong, gather the measured cache instead of the worker. The explicit queue only matters if the worker can unwind the index on its own.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
